Harvard Endowment Sees 27% Jump Fueled by SpaceX and AI

Harvard University's endowment experienced a 27% increase in its fiscal year 2026 returns. This surge was significantly boosted by investments in SpaceX, which became a top holding, and advancements in artificial intelligence.
